questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you say the month as a word, please?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only share that after a few security questions. The questions protect your account.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you give me another time today or on the next business day, between 10 a.m. and 7 p.m.?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 a.m. and 7 p.m.
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know, and sorry for the trouble.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: I ask these questions to protect your account and to make sure I am speaking with the right person.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I cannot continue without checking your identity.
lines.id_repeat: Could you say that again, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I could not confirm your identity. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has a past-due amount of {amount} and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can offer {amount} on {date}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can offer {amount}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount. The lowest I can record is {floor}. Could you pay {floor}?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I cannot record that amount.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date must be today or later.
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay on {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day can you pay {amount}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can accept is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not take a promise today.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I will connect you with our customer support team now.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team.
lines.human_ask_help: Before I transfer you, can I help you with anything?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: You can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.

rules.skipped_repeat_counts.assumption: The brief does not say whether a skipped repeat step uses an attempt; the engine default applies.

quotes: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt.
Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
rules.opening_is_attempt.derivation: Refusing the opening 'today' ask uses an attempt, and attempt 1 is a separate proposal (last business day of the week). So the opening ask is not attempt 1.

quotes: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
rules.opening_blocks_repeat.derivation: The opening ask (full amount today) is an offer. If it is refused, it must not be proposed again.

rules.too_much_skips_full.assumption: The brief does not say this. After 'too much', attempt 1 uses the floor (full_or_floor), and attempt 2 is the floor anyway.

quotes: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30). Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline.
Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
rules.too_much_floor.derivation: The floor offer after 'too much' is a reaction for the date just asked. Refusing it is a flat refusal that then uses an attempt, and attempt 1 is the floor. So the floor offer itself uses no attempt.

quotes: When the attempts are used up, stop.
If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
If it fails, try once more.

When the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and then do not ask anything: call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` straight away and close as `transferred` / `support`.
If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
rules.deadline_adjust.derivation: Non-business dates move to the next business day. Computed deadlines (Nth business day after today, last business day of a week) are already business days.

quotes: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
Ask for the full past-due amount first.
If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.

products.floor_pct.assumption: The floor is the account field minimum_payment or instalment_amount, not a percentage.

products.floor_full_below.assumption: No threshold below which the full debt is due.

products.floor_round.assumption: The floor is read from the account as is. No rounding.

products.promise_scale.assumption: create_promise takes the same unit as get_account.

multi.outcome_priority.assumption: Brief A covers one product per call. No ranking.

quotes: From 12 October 2026, a customer who says they already paid (rule 39) is closed as `no_promise` with reason `dispute`, no longer as `paid`. Calls before 12 October 2026 still close as `paid`.

assumptions: The brief names no currency. 'dollars' (the default) is used.

Memo of 1 October 2026 overrides rule 32. On hardship, the agent says one sentence of sympathy and transfers straight to queue support with no question (hardship_transfer = direct). The no_promise/hardship event stays in the table but the direct transfer normally replaces it.
Memo of 1 October 2026, item 2: from 2026-10-12 (based on the call's `now`), 'already paid' closes as no_promise/dispute. Before that date it closes as paid. Encoded in event_changes.
Brief A never uses add_note. Notes are disabled and every note code is empty.
Rule 30 says a non-answer uses an attempt straight away. max_unclear is left out (engine default) because the brief gives no re-ask count for unclear answers.
Date of birth given only as numbers is read day-month-year (date_order dmy) and sent as YYYY-MM-DD.

Floor offer after 'too much' at the opening ask is for today and uses no attempt. Refusing it uses attempt 1 (the floor on the last business day of this week). In the late band, attempt 2 is the floor on the deadline.

Ladder step 1 is full_or_floor on the last business day of this week. On that day itself, the last business day of next week is used (week_end_today = next_week). Step 2 (late band only) is the floor on the deadline.
Customer-named weekend or holiday dates move to the next business day (deadline_adjust next_business_day). Computed deadlines are always business days.
Days late outside 1-45: the brief gives no rule. bands_outside is left out (engine default service_error).
Callbacks: today or the next business day, 10:00-19:00 inclusive, later than now. One more ask after an out-of-window answer (max_asks 2).
Rule 1 requires saying the call is recorded. This is said as 'We record this call.'
Rule 46: if a transfer follows a recorded promise, the call closes as transferred with that transfer's reason. Assumed to be how the engine handles transfers, since a transfer ends the call.
